notes.title: Update notes for July 19 2023
notes.notes:
Patch notes:


 Some achievements have been removed, making it possible for the players to earn them all after completing the game
 Hat prices have been lowered
 Level selection is now a grid, making it easier for players to navigate
 Camera shake after an undo action has been removed
 Full resolution toggle fixes
 Performance updates
 Cutscene/Splash screen skip option (by pressing any key)
 Minor bugfixes
 Minor UI improvements


Thanks for the constructive feedback! :D
